items.headline: Hudbay, Mitsubishi Approve Construction of Big Copper Project in Arizona
items.summary: Hudbay Minerals and partner Mitsubishi have formally approved construction of what promises to be the next major copper mine in the U.S., with production set to begin in the back half of 2029.
